units.source_text: 本来他就没有真心期待也许能获得的成果。

en.t: In the first place, he had not sincerely expected any result he might be able to obtain.

units.source_text: 他已经习惯了被岔开话题的待遇。

en.t: He had already grown used to being treated with evasions and changes of subject.

units.source_text: 所以，当先前那个老头立刻随第二次搬运大网篮的家伙们一起赶来，回应他的要求的时候，

en.t: So when the old man from before immediately came hurrying over with the men carrying the large net basket for the second time, in response to his request,

units.source_text: 他颇感意外，甚至有些手足无措了。

en.t: he was quite surprised, and even became somewhat at a loss.
